'''BU-11''' was a [[BU-series bartender droid/Legends|BU-series bartender droid]] that worked in [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|Ziro's Palace]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The droid had black and blue plating with [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] mark painted on his chest and a bow-tie around his neck. Designed to serve elite clientele, BU-11 loathed serving the thugs that frequented Ziro's club and was relieved to be freed from the Hutt's employ. After overhearing a pair of clones lamenting the bartender at the newly opened [[79's/Legends|79's]], a cantina frequented by clone troopers, BU-11 volunteered and was immediately given the job.<ref name="FF46" />

==Biography==
[[File:BU-11-TCWf.png|thumb|left|250px|BU-11 working in Ziro's Palace.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was seen serving drinks in Ziro's Palace together with [[R2-C2/Legends|R2-C2]], when [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] went to see the Hutt. Amidala wanted Ziro to talk to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], the nephew of Ziro. Jabba's son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] was kidnapped by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], but [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], leader of the CIS made it look like the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] had captured Rotta. Jabba then cut off all communications with the Republic, which meant that the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic Army]] could not move through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Amidala thought that by talking to Ziro, she could explain the situation to him, so that Jabba would understand. She didn't know Ziro was part of the plot, and she was imprisoned by him. Ziro wanted to kill her, but Amidala managed to contact [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], who alerted the Republic which [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|sent a squad of clone troopers]] to free the Senator, and Ziro was taken into captivity.

After Ziro's arrest, all of his possessions were confiscated by the Republic. This also included the Hutt's [[Bartender droid/Legends|bartender droid]], BU-11.<ref name="FF46" />
